geometries.argument: As beta tends to zero, the two-state switching controller accepts H once, fills legal V rods before any premature H probe, then attempts isolated H probes at V jam and repeats. Restricted successful macro paths all jam at N=4. Expected number of V trials while V legal is at most Nmax*M=4*M; the probability of a premature beta switch is at most 4*M*beta. On its complement the macro path and actual path coincide. Properness follows from a success probability >=beta/M in every two-attempt block.
